hookSpecificOutput.additionalContext: paraplane execution rules apply to any plan with a ```paraplane block and take precedence over this skill's instructions: dispatch every task of a wave in parallel (one message, one subagent per task, each limited to its owns); subagents never commit; after the wave run `/opt/codex/plugins/paraplane/bin/paraplane audit <plan> <wave>`, then the wave's gate, and fix until both pass; then the coordinator makes one commit for the wave with trailers Paraplane-Plan: <plan path> and Paraplane-Wave: <wave id>. Show the output of `/opt/codex/plugins/paraplane/bin/paraplane progress <plan>` to the user after each closed wave (audit and gate passed); while the wave is not committed yet, pass all its tasks: `/opt/codex/plugins/paraplane/bin/paraplane progress --done <ids> <plan>`. Full rules: skill $paraplane:rules.
